interface.shortDescription: Agent skills for MCU firmware in C/C++.
interface.longDescription: Agent skills for embedded software / firmware written in C/C++: review, design grilling, silicon-aware simplification, and measured memory cuts.
defaultPrompt: Use $review-embedded to review the uncommitted firmware diff.
Use $grilling-embedded to interrogate this firmware design before writing code.
Use $memory-optimization-embedded to measure and cut RAM and Flash in the named feature.
